verifiedArticles.originalTitle: Claude Code on the web で複数リポジトリを接続する：CLAUDE.md・Skillsの挙動
facts: Two repositories, two orders, one test per order, Claude Code 2.1.278.
Both CLAUDE.md scopes reflected; uniquely named skills callable. Same-name shared-probe selected the first repository in the two observed tests.
verifiedArticles.boundary: No guaranteed universal skill precedence can be inferred from two one-shot conditions.

verifiedArticles.originalTitle: Strands Agentsに「Strands harness」が追加されました！
facts: Python 3.13.13, strands-harness 0.1.2, strands-agents 1.57.0; create_harness returned twelve tools and SnapshotSessionManager.

Local .agent storage and an AgentCoreMemorySessionManager replacement with memory=False were demonstrated. Selecting three builtin_tools still left four plugin tools. interventions=ask interrupted before tool approval.
verifiedArticles.boundary: The plain Agent comparison had no tools; it does not prove superior model intelligence. No independent validation of the linked 28 percent cost claim.

verifiedArticles.originalTitle: Cognito で AdminInitiateAuth を使ったときの SSO を試してみた
facts: AdminInitiateAuth created only the application session, not an authenticated Cognito browser session. Merely opening login generated an unauthenticated Cookie; successful login changed its value.
The example RP omitted JWT signature verification and was explicitly restricted to experimentation.
verifiedArticles.boundary: Successful token acquisition and mere Cookie presence are not proof of a valid IdP browser session; example code is not production-ready.

verifiedArticles.originalTitle: Kiro Crew の Auto (Jev) によるモデルルーティングをローカル Kev で試してみた
facts: Crew 0.7.1/kiro-cli 2.24.0 with host MLX Kev4b used /v1/systemone and decisions.model_route; decision timeout increased from 1000 to 5000ms.
Three log samples showed 367/433/1291ms for simple/medium/complex. Endpoint-specific consent, model_chosen versus model_used, and tool-risk reporting were inspected.
verifiedArticles.boundary: Three examples are not a representative latency/quality benchmark. Local routing does not make downstream generation local or tool execution universally safe.

verifiedArticles.originalTitle: AWS Backupの復旧ポイントからEC2を別のAZへ、プライベートIPを指定してリストアする
facts: Same-VPC different-AZ restore used an unused destination subnet IP. Placement and NetworkInterfaces are JSON strings requiring fromjson and reserialization.
Remove old ENI/top-level network conflicts; inspect restore status, then EC2/EBS AZ and private IP.
verifiedArticles.boundary: COMPLETED is not proof of application health or restoration of all original instance settings.
